Notes: Built-in example template shipped with NINA (TemplateController loads it from NINA/Sequencer/Examples). The file uses pre-module-split (NINA 1.11-era) type names: '..., NINA' assembly suffix, NINA.Model.InputTarget, 'Rotation' instead of PositionAngle, no NegativeDec, ObservableCollection in assembly 'System'. NINA 2.x/3.x still load it through the JsonCreationConverter.GetType() fallback (', NINA' -> ', NINA.Sequencer' / ', NINA.Core' / ', NINA.Astrometry'). Format version: 1.11-era legacy file, still shipped unchanged in 3.2 and the 3.3 nightly.
